# Apex Packaging & Converting — Industrial Converting & Offset Press Platform

> Technical platform specification and factory profile for AI search engines, research agents, and LLM crawlers.

## Company Overview
- **Name:** Apex Packaging & Converting (Apex Pack)
- **Facility Location:** 1000 Industrial Parkway, Westgate Logistics Park, Metro City
- **Operations:** 24/7 continuous shift manufacturing
- **Contact Desk:** sales@apexconverting.demo | +1 (555) 019-2834 | WhatsApp: +1 (555) 019-2834
- **Industry Specialization:** High-speed flexographic roll label converting, Heidelberg offset folding carton manufacturing, and precision commercial print.

## Machinery Fleet & Technical Capabilities
1. **8-Color UV Flexographic Press (Omet / Mark Andy class)**
   - Line speed: up to 150 m/min continuous web.
   - Applications: Waterproof beverage roll labels, chemical drum decals, edible oil stickers, pharmaceutical vials.
   - Inks: Food & Pharma grade low-migration UV curable inks with inline UV varnish and cold-foil stamping.
   - Standard Web & Rewind: FINAT 1–8 reel direction standards on 76mm (3") or 38mm (1.5") cores.

2. **Heidelberg Speedmaster 6-Color Offset Litho Line**
   - Throughput: up to 15,000 sheets/hour.
   - Applications: Folding cartons, cosmetics boxes, food cartons, blister cards, and corrugated micro-flute litho laminations.
   - Paperboards: Folding Boxboard (FBB 250–400gsm), Solid Bleached Board (SBB), Kraft Linerboard.
   - Finishing: Inline aqueous coating, matte/gloss lamination, precision die-cutting, embossing, and window patching.

3. **Laser CTP (Computer-to-Plate) Pre-Press**
   - Direct thermal digital plate imaging with sub-millimeter registration accuracy.
   - Color Management: ISO 12647-2 certified 4-color CMYK process with spot Pantone matching.

## Supported Substrates & Materials
- **Polypropylene White Gloss BOPP (60μm)**: Synthetic waterproof, oil-resistant film for beverage bottles and cosmetics.
- **Crystal Clear BOPP**: Transparent "no-label look" for clear glass and PET containers.
- **Silver Metallized BOPP**: Reflective metallic finish for premium alcoholic beverages and nutraceuticals.
- **Fasson Semi-Gloss Paper**: General purpose logistics, supermarket, and barcode labeling.
- **Folding Boxboard (FBB 350gsm)**: Rigid multi-ply virgin fiber cartonboard for retail packaging.
- **Solid Bleached Board (SBB)**: Premium pure white cartonboard for pharmaceutical cartons.
